title: Chapter 346 King Kong Barbie Wang Cuilian
content:
Chapter 346 King Kong Barbie Wang Cuilian

Carefully passing through a dense forest, in the open space in the distance, a giant tiger with sharp fangs was fighting fiercely with two people.

A thin man, holding a long sword, was agile.

The other person was a round-faced woman with a strong physique, not inferior to the man at all, and had two pigtails on her head.

A terrible wound had been cut on the tiger's body. Obviously, the roar just now was probably made when it was injured.

Wang Shuo rode on Da Huang and suddenly appeared in everyone's sight, making Wang Shuo unable to be the sixth.

Seeing Wang Shuo appear, the two became alert.

"Hello!"

Wang Shuo waved awkwardly.

After thinking about it, they might not understand the Blue Star language.

So he said in the North Sea Empire language: "Excuse me, you continue!"

Then he turned and left.

After walking for a while, he turned back and wanted to hide nearby to observe.

After all, the fisherman is the real fragrance!

Perhaps Da Huang had no intention of hiding, so it carried Wang Shuo and rushed out of the dense forest.

Wang Shuo was very upset.

"Ha! We meet again! Sorry... to bother you... see you later!"

Wang Shuo wanted to find a crack in the ground to bury Da Huang!

He turned around again and left in style.

This time Wang Shuo was more careful and drove Da Huang back to the breeding space.

Then he quietly turned back again, found a bush and hid.

The two people and the tiger who were confronting each other in the distance were all confused by Wang Shuo.

"Wang Cuilian, if it doesn't work, let's retreat first. I think the kid just now was a little weird."

"Swan, you are too cowardly!"

"This saber-toothed tiger will definitely explode a demon pill. Are you sure you don't want it?"

"Fuck, the brave will die of overeating and the timid will die of starvation. Let's make a quick decision."

Wang Shuo heard the conversation between the two.

He almost couldn't help it.

One is called "Wang Cuilian", who looks like a King Kong Barbie, and the other is called "Si Wan", I still have eight barrels!

After a stalemate, the saber-toothed tiger roared again and pounced on Wang Cuilian.

Wang Cuilian was not afraid at all, raised her fist as big as a sandbag, and rushed forward.

This blow directly broke off a tiger tooth of the saber-toothed tiger.

Wang Shuo's eyes widened.

Which of you two is the tiger? !

What a tiger girl!

Swan seized the opportunity and stabbed the tiger with a sword again.

The tiger roared continuously.

But the saber-toothed tiger was huge and could still withstand a beating.

The battle continued.

The huge tiger roar attracted the nearby generals and wild beasts.

After a while, three more people and two beasts came.

Swan realized that something was wrong and stopped immediately.

"Friend, you are standing by like this, isn't it inappropriate?"

"What's inappropriate? We are just passing by, you continue."

"Damn, only fools continue."

Swan and Wang Cuilian also left the battlefield.

The saber-toothed tiger wanted to escape, but at this time it was surrounded by five people and two beasts.

Strictly speaking, these beasts can no longer be called beasts, but demons.

The level should be the golden boss level.

Each of them is extremely powerful and their IQ is also terrifyingly high.

At this moment, a big bald head among the three people who just came kicked a stone and shot it directly at Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo dodged casually, and the stone did not hit him, but he could no longer hide his body.

Exposed.

"Friend, you have watched the excitement for so long, why not come out and get to know each other!"

The bald head forced Wang Shuo out, as if he had done something very ordinary.

Wang Shuo was angry in his heart, but he did not show it.

"Ha! I had a stomachache just now. Look, my legs are numb from squatting."

Wang Shuo deliberately moved his legs exaggeratedly, doing pre-fight warm-up.

Everyone immediately cast contemptuous looks at him.

I don't believe you!
